en.name: Basilica of the Immaculate Conception, Lourdes
en.summary: The upper basilica built above the grotto where Bernadette Soubirous reported apparitions of the Virgin Mary.
en.body: Consecrated in 1876 above the grotto of Massabielle, the basilica anchors the sanctuary complex at Lourdes, one of the world's most visited Catholic pilgrimage sites and a recognized international shrine.
